text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — Lantern wants a 3-day POC to validate swapping their current API to Redwood. Main asks: API compatibility, cost comparison (50M/mo tokens), and answers to their security questionnaire. They want kickoff Thurs morning if we can.

diego-eng: Can we confirm differences up front: streaming semantics, request-id headers, rate-limit response shape, and tokenizer/token counting? Need to map their adapter calls to our endpoints.

priya-ps: I recommend a focused scope: day1 parity (functional + semantic), day2 perf/load, day3 wrap + handoff. Request: Lantern to send ~2k seed prompts and a small set of "must-match" assertions.

lee-sec: Lantern requires SOC2 summary, KMS integration notes, audit log retention windows, and ability to redact PII in logs. Also asking about VPC tunnels and customer-managed keys.

olivia-devx: Quick mapping example we can provide to them:

```bash
# Lantern -> Redwood mapping (chat endpoint)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "client_request_id: $CLIENT_ID" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.1-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"'$PROMPT'"}],"stream":false}'

# note: we will echo client_request_id into x-request-id on our side for parity
```

priya-ps: Important: Lantern's tokenizer yields slightly different token counts which changes cost math. We'll normalize by running both tokenizers on the prompt set and report a normalized cost delta.

diego-eng: Also call out determinism: seeding and temperature semantics vary. We should propose an "equivalence" rubric (semantic similarity >0.9 using embedding cosine + human spot-check for edge cases).

maria-sales: On pricing they asked for per-token parity + a year1 committed discount. Can we ballpark month-to-month and reserved capacity for 50M tokens? Also confirm Dedicated/reserved options exist.

lee-sec: Legal wants to see DPA language + deletion API. I'll draft answers and ask Legal to prepare a DPA template. We can show a sample deletion request flow.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Provisioning staging pool for Lantern POC: 2 x a2-medium-gpu nodes in staging-west. Expected ready in 36h.

olivia-devx: I'll put together a small test harness that: 1) normalizes inputs (strip vendor headers), 2) runs 2k prompt parity checks, 3) computes token-normalized cost, 4) produces a report. Will include runbook and quickstart.

diego-eng: For safe rollouts recommend an A/B routing rule + fallback to smaller model if latency SLO breaks. Example route: 

```yaml
routes:
  - name: lantern-poc-route
    match: { header: { 'x-customer': 'lantern' } }
    primary: redwood-1.1-large
    fallback: redwood-1-small
    latency_slo_ms: 300
```

priya-ps: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: ["semantic parity >= 95% on seed set","p50 latency < 200ms / p95 < 450ms","normalized cost delta <= 12%","security checklist items addressed (SOC2 + DPA + KMS/PEM options)"]

maria-sales: Action list: 1) I'll schedule the Thurs kickoff 9am PT and invite Lantern + Legal, 2) ask Lantern for their seed prompts + security questionnaire today, 3) engineering to give rough cost numbers for 50M tokens + reserved options, 4) security to start the DPA draft.

lee-sec: I'll ping Lantern's compliance contact and request the questionnaire now. Will also assemble SOC2 artifacts we can share.

priya-ps: Once infra is up (thanks infra-bot) I can start parity runs Thu-Fri. I will produce the POC report and acceptance matrix.

maria-sales: Great, thanks team. I'll post Lantern's questionnaire here when it arrives and loop in Legal. :thumbsup:
